format: JavaScript (React-like component with LightningJS's Blits library)
description: This file defines a LightningJS component named 'NotesList' which displays a list of notes, allows creating new notes, and handles selection and focus. It imports external modules for theming, state management, and note list items, and interacts heavily with the store to synchronize state.

classes.name: NotesList
classes.description: A LightningJS component that renders a list of notes, manages focus and selection, and provides methods for creating notes and changing selection.

methods.name: _syncFromStore
methods.description: Synchronizes the component's internal state with the global store by fetching notes, sorting them, and updating selected note and focus index.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Public method that adds a new empty note to the store.

methods.name: _moveSelection
methods.description: Moves the current selection up or down within the list of notes based on a delta value.
